import type { Camera } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import { getCameraPosition, getEffectiveAspectRatio, getViewMatrix, getViewProjectionMatrix, projectWorldToScreen, resolveCameraViewport } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function labelPosition(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, point: {x: number; y: number; z: number}) {
  const backingWidth = canvas.width;
  const backingHeight = canvas.height;
  const cssRect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cssWidth = cssRect.width || canvas.clientWidth || backingWidth;
  const cssHeight = cssRect.height || canvas.clientHeight || backingHeight;
  const targetWidth = backingWidth > 0 ? backingWidth : cssWidth;
  const targetHeight = backingHeight > 0 ? backingHeight : cssHeight;
  if (targetWidth <= 0 || targetHeight <= 0 || cssWidth <= 0 || cssHeight <= 0) return {x:0,y:0,visible:false};
  const viewport = resolveCameraViewport(camera, targetWidth, targetHeight);
  if (viewport.width <= 0 || viewport.height <= 0) return {x:0,y:0,visible:false};
  const aspect = getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera, targetWidth, targetHeight);
  const view = getViewMatrix(camera);
  const viewProjection = getViewProjectionMatrix(camera, aspect);
  const worldOrigin = camera._useFloatingOrigin ? getCameraPosition(camera) : undefined;
  try {
    const result = projectWorldToScreen(point, view, viewProjection, { viewport, backingWidth: targetWidth, backingHeight: targetHeight, cssWidth, cssHeight, worldOrigin });
    const x = Number.isFinite(result.cssX) ? result.cssX : Number.isFinite(result.x) ? result.x : 0;
    const y = Number.isFinite(result.cssY) ? result.cssY : Number.isFinite(result.y) ? result.y : 0;
    const inFront = !result.behindCamera && Number.isFinite(result.clipW) && result.clipW > 0;
    const visible = inFront && !result.offscreen;
    return {x, y, visible};
  } catch { return {x:0,y:0,visible:false}; }
}
```

  getEffectiveAspectRatio,
  getViewMatrix,
  getViewProjectionMatrix,

  resolveCameraViewport,
} from "@babylonjs/lite";

type Vec3Like = { x: number; y: number; z: number };
type ViewportLike = { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };

function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number { ... }
function positiveDimension(...values: unknown[]): number { ... }
function clampViewport(viewport: unknown, targetWidth: number, targetHeight: number): ViewportLike | null { ... }
function notVisible(): { x: number; y: number; visible: boolean } { return { x: 0, y: 0, visible: false }; }

export function labelPosition(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, point: { x: number; y: number; z: number }): { x: number; y: number; visible: boolean } {
  try {
    if (!camera || !canvas || !point) return notVisible();
    const px = toFiniteNumber(point.x); ...
    if (!Number.isFinite(px) ...) return notVisible();

    const backingWidth = positiveDimension(canvas.width);
    const backingHeight = positiveDimension(canvas.height);

    let rectWidth = NaN; let rectHeight = NaN;
    try {
      const canvasLike = canvas as any;
      if (typeof canvasLike.getBoundingClientRect === "function") {
        const rect = canvasLike.getBoundingClientRect();
        rectWidth = Number(rect?.width);
        rectHeight = Number(rect?.height);
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }

    const cssWidth = positiveDimension(rectWidth, canvas.clientWidth, backingWidth);
    const cssHeight = positiveDimension(rectHeight, canvas.clientHeight, backingHeight);
    if (cssWidth <= 0 || cssHeight <= 0) return notVisible();

    const targetWidth = backingWidth > 0 ? backingWidth : cssWidth;
    const targetHeight = backingHeight > 0 ? backingHeight : cssHeight;
    if (targetWidth <= 0 || targetHeight <= 0) return notVisible();

    const clampedViewport = clampViewport(resolveCameraViewport(camera, targetWidth, targetHeight), targetWidth, targetHeight);
    if (!clampedViewport) return notVisible();

    let aspect = clampedViewport.width / clampedViewport.height;
    if (!Number.isFinite(aspect) || aspect <= 0) {
      aspect = toFiniteNumber(getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera, targetWidth, targetHeight));
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(aspect) || aspect <= 0) return notVisible();

    const view = getViewMatrix(camera);
    const viewProjection = getViewProjectionMatrix(camera, aspect);
    if (!view || !viewProjection) return notVisible();

    let worldOrigin: Vec3Like | undefined;
    if (camera._useFloatingOrigin) {
      const pos = getCameraPosition(camera);
      const worldX = toFiniteNumber(pos?.x); ...
      if (!Number.isFinite(worldX) ...) return notVisible();
      worldOrigin = { x: worldX, y: worldY, z: worldZ };
    }

    const options: any = {
      viewport: clampedViewport,
      backingWidth: targetWidth,
      backingHeight: targetHeight,
      cssWidth,
      cssHeight,
    };
    if (worldOrigin) options.worldOrigin = worldOrigin;

    const result = projectWorldToScreen({ x: px, y: py, z: pz } as any, view, viewProjection, options);
    if (!result) return notVisible();

    const scaleX = cssWidth / targetWidth;
    const scaleY = cssHeight / targetHeight;
    const canScaleX = Number.isFinite(scaleX) && scaleX > 0;
    const canScaleY = Number.isFinite(scaleY) && scaleY > 0;

    const cssXRaw = toFiniteNumber(result.cssX);
    const backingXRaw = toFiniteNumber(result.x);
    const cssYRaw = toFiniteNumber(result.cssY);
    const backingYRaw = toFiniteNumber(result.y);

    let xCss = cssXRaw;
    let xViewport = backingXRaw;
    if (!Number.isFinite(xCss) && Number.isFinite(xViewport)) xCss = canScaleX ? xViewport * scaleX : xViewport;
    if (!Number.isFinite(xViewport) && Number.isFinite(xCss)) xViewport = canScaleX ? xCss / scaleX : xCss;
    let xOut = Number.isFinite(xCss) ? xCss : Number.isFinite(xViewport) ? (canScaleX ? xViewport * scaleX : xViewport) : 0;
    if (!Number.isFinite(xOut)) xOut = Number.isFinite(xViewport) ? xViewport : 0;
    // y similarly

    const hasX = Number.isFinite(cssXRaw) || Number.isFinite(backingXRaw);
    const hasY = Number.isFinite(cssYRaw) || Number.isFinite(backingYRaw);
    const finiteCoords = hasX && hasY && Number.isFinite(xOut) && Number.isFinite(yOut);

    const clipWRaw = Number(result.clipW);
    const behind = Boolean(result.behindCamera);
    const front = !behind && (Number.isNaN(clipWRaw) || clipWRaw > 0);

    const offscreen = Boolean(result.offscreen);
    const tolerance = 1e-9 * Math.max(1, clampedViewport.width, clampedViewport.height);
    const inViewport = Number.isFinite(xViewport) && Number.isFinite(yViewport) &&
      xViewport >= clampedViewport.x - tolerance &&
      xViewport <= clampedViewport.x + clampedViewport.width + tolerance &&
      yViewport >= clampedViewport.y - tolerance &&
      yViewport <= clampedViewport.y + clampedViewport.height + tolerance;

    const visible = front && !offscreen && inViewport && finiteCoords;
    return { x: xOut, y: yOut, visible };
  } catch {
    return notVisible();
  }

import type { Camera } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import {
  getCameraPosition,

  getViewMatrix,
  getViewProjectionMatrix,
  projectWorldToScreen,
  resolveCameraViewport,
} from "@babylonjs/lite";

type ViewportLike = { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };

function readNumber(obj: unknown, key: string, throwValue = NaN): number {
  try {
    const value = (obj as any)?.[key];
    return Number(value);
  } catch {
    return throwValue;
  }
}

function readBoolean(obj: unknown, key: string, throwValue: boolean): boolean {
  try {
    const value = (obj as any)?.[key];
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return false;
    if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isNaN(value)) return throwValue;
    return Boolean(value);
  } catch {
    return throwValue;
  }
}

function positiveDimension(...values: number[]): number {
  for (const value of values) {
    if (Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0) return value;
  }
  return 0;
}

function clampViewport(viewport: unknown, targetWidth: number, targetHeight: number): ViewportLike | null {
  const x = readNumber(viewport, "x");
  const y = readNumber(viewport, "y");
  const width = readNumber(viewport, "width");
  const height = readNumber(viewport, "height");
  if (!Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(y) || !Number.isFinite(width) || !Number.isFinite(height) || width <= 0 || height <= 0) return null;
  const left = Math.max(0, x);
  const top = Math.max(0, y);
  const right = Math.min(targetWidth, x + width);
  const bottom = Math.min(targetHeight, y + height);
  const clippedWidth = right - left;
  const clippedHeight = bottom - top;
  if (!Number.isFinite(clippedWidth) || !Number.isFinite(clippedHeight) || clippedWidth <= 0 || clippedHeight <= 0) return null;
  return { x: left, y: top, width: clippedWidth, height: clippedHeight };
}
